facts: Wombats poop cubes. Scientists think the cube shape helps it stay put so it doesn't roll away. Nature's Lego.
Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
In 1932, Australia fought a war against emus. The emus won.
Octopuses have three hearts, and two of them stop beating when they swim. Same, honestly.
Sea otters hold hands while they sleep so they don't drift apart.
A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
Honey never spoils. Archaeologists have found edible honey in ancient Egyptian tombs.
Bananas are berries, but strawberries are not.
Scotland's national animal is the unicorn.
There are more possible ways to shuffle a deck of cards than there are atoms on Earth. Every shuffle is probably a first in history.
A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
Cows have best friends and get stressed when they're separated.
The inventor of the Pringles can was buried with some of his ashes in a Pringles can.
Sharks existed before trees did.
The shortest war in history, between Britain and Zanzibar in 1896, lasted about 38 minutes.
Kangaroos can't walk backwards.
A shrimp's heart is in its head.
Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
Nintendo was founded in 1889, and it started out making playing cards.
There's a species of jellyfish that can basically reverse its aging. It's called the immortal jellyfish.
Pigeons can tell the difference between a Picasso and a Monet. Researchers actually tested it.
A cloud can weigh more than a million pounds.
The fingerprints of a koala are so close to human ones that they could confuse a crime scene.
Rats laugh when you tickle them. It's too high-pitched for us to hear.
Hot water can freeze faster than cold water under some conditions. It's called the Mpemba effect.
Saturn is less dense than water. In a big enough bathtub, it would float.
Butterflies taste with their feet.
The Eiffel Tower can grow about six inches taller in summer because the metal expands in the heat.
Goats have accents. Their bleats change depending on the group they hang out with.
Humans share about 60 percent of their DNA with bananas.
A snail can sleep for up to three years. Absolute legend.
The dot over a lowercase i or j is called a tittle.
Ketchup was sold in the 1830s as a medicine.
Male seahorses are the ones that get pregnant and give birth.
Crows can recognize human faces and hold grudges against specific people for years.
Lobster used to be considered poor people's food. Some servants in colonial America complained about being fed it too often.
Polar bear fur isn't white. It's transparent, and their skin is black.
The heart of a blue whale is about the size of a small car.
A bolt of lightning is about five times hotter than the surface of the sun.
Peanuts aren't nuts. They're legumes, like beans.
Your stomach gets a new lining every few days so it doesn't digest itself.
Dolphins give each other names. Each one has a signature whistle the others use to call it.
There's a town in Norway called Hell, and it freezes over every winter.
The first oranges weren't orange. Many were green.
Astronauts grow up to about two inches taller in space because their spine stretches out.
Squirrels plant thousands of trees every year by forgetting where they buried their nuts.
The longest hiccup streak on record lasted 68 years.
Sloths can hold their breath longer than dolphins can, up to about 40 minutes.
A single strand of spaghetti is called a spaghetto.
Bees can recognize human faces.
A cat named Stubbs was the honorary mayor of a town in Alaska for about 20 years.
Penguins propose with pebbles. A male gives a female his best rock.
It's impossible to hum while holding your nose. You just tried it, didn't you.
An ostrich's eye is bigger than its brain.
The world's oldest known recipe is for beer, from ancient Mesopotamia.
Venus spins backwards compared to most planets, so the sun rises in the west there.
Elephants are one of the few animals that can recognize themselves in a mirror.
Hippo sweat is reddish and works like a natural sunscreen.
A jiffy is an actual unit of time. In physics it can mean the time light takes to travel one centimeter.
Turtles can breathe through their butts. It's called cloacal respiration.
